question: Which order-four markings are generated by the retained source time and full charge, and do they supply a physical common source without an inserted P5?
summary_de: Die vollständige Quelltorus-Suche liefert 16 Vierertorsionscharaktere, zwölf primitive und vier D5+A3-Markierungen. Der Rang5-Projektor wird rekonstruiert. Lean beweist den Gitterschnitt und die Zeit/Ladungs/Blatt-Identitäten. Ursprüngliche Felder haben jedoch vier Phasen zu je zwei, und die E8-Erweiterung samt physischer Auswahl bleibt vorausgesetzt.
summary_en: The complete source-torus search gives sixteen four-torsion characters, twelve primitive and four D5+A3 markings. The rank-five projector is reconstructed. Lean proves plane saturation and time/charge/sheet identities. Original fields instead have four phases with two fields each; the E8 extension and physical selection remain assumptions.
scope: The rational source plane generated by the recorded folded chiral time and fully normalized U1 charge in the stipulated E8 extension; no classification of arbitrary P1/P2 sources.

The stipulated even E8 current extension and recorded exact M dictionary.
The full additive charge Q, not merely its finite Wilson character.
